name: Janata Stationery & Art Bandra
description:
Established in 1970, Janata Book Centre was started by Late.Khimji Lalji Chheda which specialized in
school and college books along with school and office stationery.
Later in 1988 Mr.Ashok Khimji Chheda s/o Khimji Lalji Chheda joined the family business and introduced
a range of fine art and craft materials.
As the demand for fine art materials increased, slowly we started to focus on the fine art range.
Now we specialise in Fine Art, Architectural, Interior, Jewellery, Fashion Designing Materials, School & Office Stationery. Now the store is also known as “Janata Stationery & Art"
Soon Mr. Chheda inaugurated another store for All types of Papers & Craft Materials known as "Veerat Paper Bazar"

name: Block prints | Block print for event | Wooden block seller - FEHMIDA ART PRINTS.
description:
Hand Block Prints, Skreen Prints, Block Prints.
Hand block printing is a traditional textile art form that involves stamping patterns onto fabric using hand-carved wooden blocks. It originated in India and has been practiced for centuries. The process begins with the design being carved onto a block of wood, with each block representing a different element of the pattern. The fabric is then stretched onto a flat surface, and the block is dipped in dye and pressed onto the fabric, creating the desired pattern. This technique allows for intricate and repetitive designs to be printed on various textiles, such as cotton, silk, and linen.

featured_reviews.name: My Name
featured_reviews.review_text:
West Elm at Jio World Drive is a standout destination for home décor lovers and interior design enthusiasts. The store spans two levels (about 9,000 sq ft) and offers a wide, curated range of products that blend style, sustainability, and craftsmanship.  ￼

🏠 What You’ll Find / Product Varieties
•	Furniture: Sofas, sectionals, accent chairs, dining tables, cabinets, consoles, and more — in both modern and classic designs.  ￼
•	Home decor & accessories: Vases, planters, decorative objects, wall art, mirrors, and display items.  ￼
•	Lighting: Chandeliers, pendants, floor lamps, table lamps — design-forward lighting to match interiors.  ￼
•	Bedding & bath: Bed linens, quilts, cushions, towels, and other soft furnishings.  ￼
•	Kitchen & dining: Dinnerware, cookware, serveware, table settings, and small kitchen accessories.  ￼
•	Sustainability & Fair-trade lines: Many items are fair trade certified, use organic materials (e.g. 100% organic cotton for bed & bath), and emphasize responsibly sourced materials.  ￼
•	Exclusive / special collections: They’ve launched capsule collections (for example with designer Ashiesh Shah) for rugs, cushions, and décor, often handcrafted by artisans.  ￼

✨ Special Features & Experience
•	The store is designed as a lifestyle / experiential space, encouraging browsing and discovery rather than just transactional shopping.  ￼
•	Interiors incorporate industrial elements like exposed brick, metal accents, and a design-forward aesthetic to make the décor pieces come alive in the space.  ￼
•	They aim to refresh collections frequently, so new décor and furniture pieces rotate seasonally.  ￼
•	Design services: West Elm offers in-store / virtual design consultation (Design Crew services), room planning assistance, and interior styling help.

featured_reviews.name: Pg
featured_reviews.review_text: This West Elm at Jio World Drive in BKC, Mumbai, is a stylish home furnishings store that offers a curated selection of modern furniture, decor, and lifestyle products. Known for its commitment to sustainability and craftsmanship, West Elm features pieces that blend contemporary design with functionality. The store showcases a variety of collections, including furniture for living rooms, bedrooms, and dining areas, as well as accessories that enhance any space. With its inviting atmosphere and expert staff, West Elm aims to inspire customers to create beautiful, personalized homes while promoting ethical sourcing and supporting artisans worldwide..

featured_reviews.name: Ankita
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great experience shopping in west elm Jio mall. Great collection and was really happy with the home consultant who helped us picking the right bed linens and many other things. Want to thank Saish Kalarimadathi for his great service and suggestions.

featured_reviews.name: ANIKET PARAB
featured_reviews.review_text: Used West Elm for our Wedding Registry and multiple family and friends who ordered from them and shipped directly to us were shorted items. First was a set of 8 plates (2 boxes of 4) and only 1 box was delivered. I have Ring proof and UPS proof photo showing only 1 box. Second issue is a set of glasses that were never delivered. I will give them credit that first issue they resolve immediately when I called and the second set of plates is enroute, second issue is still outstanding. I'm writing this review because you simply shouldn't have shipment issues like this from a reputable brand. It is beyond disappointing to have to contact family/friends after my wedding to ask them if they forgot to send something or if they were charged

featured_reviews.name: JEETENDRA MAKHIJA
featured_reviews.review_text: This American furniture + design chain - one of the Williams Sonoma brands - is in 60 countries already and is now available in Jio World Drive in Mumbai.  It's basically everything you could possibly dream of in one space - think furniture, ceramics, lighting, carpets for your study; living room; bedroom; balcony; for any sort of person with varied tastes flowing over different age groups. West Elm has a range of sustainably sourced and organic decor that are fair trade certified, and you can take a look at their entire range on their Indian website and buy off it. But we suggest You make a visit to their store to see amazing variety they have. You will not be disappointed! They also design as per your requirements.

featured_reviews.name: Vijay Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrendous experience. Bought close to 10 lacs worth of furniture from them.
1. Staff expedited delivery of dining chairs because they knew it was going on sale later. Incurred a straight loss of 26k because of this non-transparency
2. Last item delivered was defective. Store staff directs you to speak to the call center. Call center exec uses a lot of English, promises a call back with resolution & then vanishes for weeks! It’s been 2 months of follow up now, but issue is still not resolved & we are saddled with a defective piece.
Premium brands need to do more than just provide glitzy shopping environments. They need to go out of their way to support customers when a problem arises.
As of now, West Elm’s Customer service is zilch

featured_reviews.name: makeupandhairbychris Christina D'Souza (makeupandhairbychris)
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the West Elm store at JWD Drive Mall, and I must say it was an outstanding experience. The store has a beautifully curated collection of modern, stylish furniture and home decor. The layout is easy to navigate, and the products are well-displayed, making it enjoyable to browse through the various options.

The staff was incredibly helpful and knowledgeable, offering great advice without being pushy. They went above and beyond to assist me in finding the perfect pieces for my home. I was particularly impressed with the quality of the items—everything felt solid and well-made.

Overall, the combination of excellent customer service, high-quality products, and a welcoming atmosphere makes this West Elm location a top destination for anyone looking to elevate their home design.

Highly recommend!
